images.description: Real prod-flavor debug build on the iPhone 16 Pro simulator, signed into a real account with existing recaps, pref unset: Home goes straight from the tabs to the conversation list with no Daily Recaps row. Conversation titles blurred for privacy.
Developer Settings > Experimental on the same simulator build: the new Daily Recaps on Home row after flipping it on.
Back on the same kept-alive Home after the toggle: the Daily Recaps row with View All is shown above Today. Recap and conversation titles blurred for privacy.
